rationale: Local as_tensor() casts non-bool numpy via astype(np.int_), silently truncating float soft_target_probs to 0. Detection reads tensor dtype (Tier 0) at dataloader output: it must be float for soft_target_probs. schema_topo_precond per anti-example 1: precond is 'this tensor is the soft_target_probs/float-input slot', not just 'any tensor'. P4 (runtime hook on dataloader output) over P1 because the field is not in the standard trace schema.
